subject: Pilot stipend slab negotiation and extended validity for Mendel RFP
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@mendelhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Inquiry: pilot stipend structure for bakeoff

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our evaluation committee is finalizing the bakeoff logistics and asked for clarification on how Redwood structures pilot stipends across multiple competitors. Specifically:

- Can Redwood provide a tiered stipend (per-seat vs pooled compute) for a 3-week bakeoff?
- Are there caps on parallel projects if we select Redwood for a follow-on paid pilot?
- Do credits expire during the evaluation window or post-termination?

I attached the current RFP (Mendel_RFP_v3.pdf). Could you share a proposed stipend slab and any precedence/examples? Procurement may need a short PO/statement to justify the stipend.

Thanks,
Alex Reynolds
Sr. Product Manager, MendelHealth
Attachment: Mendel_RFP_v3.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@mendelhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot stipend structure for bakeoff

Alex —

Appreciate the RFP. Quick answers up front:

- Yes, we can do a tiered stipend: per-seat credits for dev/test and a pooled compute allocation for large-scale generator/embeddings runs.
- No hard cap on parallel projects, but the stipend proposal usually ties to a capped token/compute budget and a defined consumption window.
- Credits are valid for 90 days from issuance unless we agree otherwise for the bakeoff window.

Drafting a proposed slab and a short justification for procurement. Looping Neha and Marissa to confirm budget and any exceptions.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-stipend-table.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@mendelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot stipend structure for bakeoff

Alex,

Quick note from ops/finance: we'd be comfortable with a two-tier slab for this RFP — Tier A (up to 50k tokens/week pooled compute + 5 seats dev credits) and Tier B (up to 200k tokens/week + 15 seats). Tier B would require a signed MSA + PO before credits are unlocked. Cancellation terms: unused credits returned to Redwood's evaluation pool after 30 days post-bakeoff.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we can extend the credit validity for the bakeoff to 180 days as a one-off?

Thanks,
Neha
Head of Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@mendelhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot stipend structure for bakeoff

Alex —

Confirmed. We're able to approve a 150% extension of credit validity for this Mendel bakeoff (extended to 180 days) provided Mendel signs the standard PO and agrees to a follow-on technical review call within 30 days of bakeoff close. Draft PO and a short procurement justification are attached.

Next steps:
- Mendel to sign PO (procurement@mendelhealth.com) and return
- Redwood will provision Tier B slab upon PO confirmation
- Schedule technical kickoff with our Solutions Engineer (I'll send availability)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Mendel_PO_draft.pdf
